meta.weighting: Region-month odds from SWF DefaultValues (MCM can change them). A filled REGN Global replaces the static Chance (engine rule; static chances shown only for global-less entries). Each in-scope region and each month counts once (no area weighting). Partner weight = share of the Picta weather's odds that lands on each Astralite weather rolling in the SAME region, month, SWF lane and bucket, split by Astralite odds; class filter first, then slot-only, class-only (unseasonal lists), fallback class.
meta.scope: Exterior regions of Tamriel, Solstheim, Bruma (BSHeartland + CYRWeather*), Wyrmstooth, city/child worldspaces, Forgotten Vale, Pale Pass, Sancre Tor and the unique MQ worldspaces. Helios interior regions and FX light regions excluded from the outdoor table (see interiors).
meta.e11_note: Picta E11 ini groups: A01_Clear.ini = A01+A02; B01_Lightly_Cloudy.ini = B01+B02 (+4 vanilla tundra IDs); A02_Clear_Mist.ini = A03; B02_Lightly_Cloudy_Misty_Fog.ini = B03; summer A01 ini = 5AFA01+5AFA02, summer B01 ini = 5AFB01+5AFB02. Soul Core E11 is class-level (SoulClear.ini covers every Clear{XX}), so at the ini layer the region family does not matter; at the WTHR-record layer it does (Astralite regional variants differ by a median 38-83/255 per colour slot).

picta_rotation.note: Clear: identical record colours to A02; E11 ini A01_Clear.ini serves both A01 and A02.
Clear aurora: shares record colours and the E11 ini A01_Clear.ini with A01 (identical colour slots verified).

Clear + ground mist: colour partner = Astralite Clear*; Astralite clear weathers carry no mist, so the mist half has no Astralite donor (fog lens: borrow mist only from Astralite Fog* or the Soul RFCT mists, not from the clear partner).

Lightly cloudy: panorama-only sky like A01; slot partner = Astralite Clear*; sky-likeness alternative = Astralite Cloudy* (listed under alt_partners_sky_likeness). Shares E11 ini B01_Lightly_Cloudy.ini with B02.
Lightly cloudy aurora: SWF PleasantA slot; Astralite fills PleasantA with Clear*_A and Cloudy*_A, so partners split between both. Shares E11 ini with B01.

Misty fog: SWF Overcast slot. Where Snowy Holds gives Astralite no Overcast entry (snow-lane SN regions and the Whiterun tundra family) the pairing falls back to Astralite Cloudy*; the fog half should come from Astralite Fog* only.
Cloudy: also the Picta lane climate fallback (PIC_CLMT_Skyrim -> C01 100%); Astralite lane fallback SkyrimClimate -> SkyrimCloudy 100% (same pairing).
Cloudy-storm (dry, windy, Pleasant flag): slot partner Astralite Cloudy*; alt = StormRain* sky without rain.
Cloudy light fog: same slot logic as B03.
Very light rain under cloud: partner Astralite OvercastRain*.
Very light snow under cloud: partner SkyrimOvercastSnow (+Seasons_CloudySnow/Seasons_OvercastSnow where Wyrmstooth/Bruma rolls them).

Overcast (no fog, no precip): Astralite has NO plain overcast weather; its Overcast slot is filled by Fog* weathers, so the slot partner is fog-heavy (day fog far 10k-25k vs Picta 150k). Sky-likeness alternative = Astralite OvercastRain* sky without the rain (Soul SoulOvercast.ini). Do not copy Astralite fog DISTANCE onto D01 from the slot partner.
picta_rotation.helios_exit_script_reverse_map: Skyrim*Overcast* (only names with none of Snow/Storm/Rain/Fog/Cloudy/Clear)

picta_rotation.note: Overcast heavy fog: cleanest fog partner = Astralite Fog* (SoulFog.ini / SoulFogOvercast.ini).
Dry thunderstorm (Cloudy flag, no precip): slot partner Astralite StormRain*; regions whose Astralite list has no StormRain fall back to OvercastRain*.
Dry cold thunderstorm (Cloudy flag, no precip, SWF Snow_Storm slot): partner SkyrimStormSnow (Astralite has no dry snow storm).
Extreme snow: SkyrimStormSnow; SkyrimStormSnowBlizzard only rolls in one Astralite region (Forgotten Vale ice lake).
Clear: identical record colours to A02; E11 ini A01_Clear.ini serves both A01 and A02.
Clear aurora: shares record colours and the E11 ini A01_Clear.ini with A01 (identical colour slots verified).

Clear + ground mist: colour partner = Astralite Clear*; Astralite clear weathers carry no mist, so the mist half has no Astralite donor (fog lens: borrow mist only from Astralite Fog* or the Soul RFCT mists, not from the clear partner).

Lightly cloudy: panorama-only sky like A01; slot partner = Astralite Clear*; sky-likeness alternative = Astralite Cloudy* (listed under alt_partners_sky_likeness). Shares E11 ini B01_Lightly_Cloudy.ini with B02.
Lightly cloudy aurora: SWF PleasantA slot; Astralite fills PleasantA with Clear*_A and Cloudy*_A, so partners split between both. Shares E11 ini with B01.

interiors.twin_weather_records_picta_lane: All 85 Helios_<name> WTHR are won by Helios.esp (houseCARL aggregate) = Helios default interior grade, NOT Astralite-graded. In the PBR lane Helios_Astralite.esp overrides 84 of them and Dawn Warmth re-wins 64 (forwards).

interior_regions_picta_lane.retime_rule: snow entries moved from Common to Autumn+Winter copies (no summer snow), rain moved from Common to Spring/Summer/Autumn copies (no winter rain), some regional rain twins (Helios_SkyrimOvercastRainTU/FF/VT/MA) swapped for the generic Helios_SkyrimOvercastRain

interiors.entry_logic: Helios_Alias (Authoria Picta exit-weather build) builds "Helios_"+outgoing EditorID on entry. No Helios_PIC_WTHR_MASTER_* / SUMMER_* twin exists (the only Helios_PIC_* record is A10001 Helios_PIC_WTHR_SKYFPF_01_Clear, a Picta 1.0 stub), so every Picta outdoor weather misses the twin lookup -> ForceCurrentWeather(); the interior then shows whatever its Helios interior region rolls (Helios twins named after vanilla/Astralite weathers, seasonally gated by Picta Seasonal). Outdoor-to-indoor MATCH does not exist in the Picta lane.
interiors.exit_logic: On exit a Helios_Skyrim*/Helios_DLC1_Skyrim* twin is mapped by PictaEquivalent(): Snow+Storm->E05, Snow->D05, Storm->E03, Rain->D03, Fog->D02, Cloudy_A->B02, Cloudy->C01, Clear_A->A02, Clear->A01, Overcast->D01, names containing War or not starting Skyrim/DLC1_Skyrim -> no mapping (original lookup). GameMonth 5-7 swaps A01/A02/A03/B01/B02 for the injected SUMMER variants. This is the existing reverse (Astralite-name -> Picta) pairing table and agrees with the forward table here except A03/B01/B03/C02/C03/C04/C05/D04/D06/E01/E02/E04/E06, which the exit map never targets.
interiors.e11_interiors: Picta lane E11 routes interiors by LOCATION (_locationweather.ini section [0], 961 bare lines -> fake ids AA001/AA004/AA007 -> Authoria - Interiors/House|Inn|Dungeon.ini); no Helios twin FormID appears in either lane's _weatherlist.ini, so twins never get their own E11 file in either lane.
interiors.pairing_implication: Interior "Astralite colours" in the baby = tick Helios_Astralite.esp (needs Astralite Weathers.esp as an ACTIVE master; it is ESL-flagged, 147 records) or forward its 84 twin colour sets into a baby plugin; region wiring stays Picta Seasonal's 35 REGN (already Helios-twin-based, seasonally retimed). Twin names are vanilla names, so the twin <-> Astralite weather pairing is identity (Helios_SkyrimClearTU <-> SkyrimClearTU).
